```{python}
# | echo: false
# | output: asis
# Key-findings box (#320): a renderer of key_findings.json, which the fit
# pipeline (or scripts/regenerate_key_findings.py) generates from the fit's own
# CSVs. All sentence logic lives in reporting.generate_key_findings so the prose
# cannot drift from the computation (#271). It independently rechecks the current
# automatic gate so stale "ok" JSON cannot release findings after a failed refit.
# Deliberately self-contained (no _setup.qmd dependency) so it remains robust in
# the #321 findings-first order.
import json as _kf_json
from pathlib import Path as _KFPath

from language_reading_predictors.statistical_models.reporting import (
    convergence_gate_clean_passed as _kf_gate_clean_passed,
)

_kf_path = _KFPath(".") / "key_findings.json"
_kf_gate_path = _KFPath(".") / "diagnostics_summary.json"
_kf_config_path = _KFPath(".") / "config.json"
try:
    with open(_kf_gate_path) as _kf_gate_fh:
        _kf_gate = _kf_json.load(_kf_gate_fh)
except (FileNotFoundError, OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, _kf_json.JSONDecodeError):
    _kf_gate = None

_kf_gate_is_clean = _kf_gate_clean_passed(_kf_gate)
_kf_blending_required = False
_kf_blending_ready = True
_kf_blending_reason = ""
_kf_blending_sha256 = None
_kf_missingness_required = False
_kf_missingness_ready = True
_kf_missingness_reason = ""
_kf_missingness_sha256 = None
if _kf_gate_is_clean:
    try:
        with open(_kf_config_path) as _kf_config_fh:
            _kf_config = _kf_json.load(_kf_config_fh)
    except (
        FileNotFoundError,
        OSError,
        UnicodeDecodeError,
        _kf_json.JSONDecodeError,
    ):
        _kf_config = None
    if isinstance(_kf_config, dict) and _kf_config.get("outcome_symbol") == "B":
        from language_reading_predictors.statistical_models.blending_sensitivity import (
            evaluate_local_blending_link_sensitivity as _kf_evaluate_blending,
        )

        _kf_blending_required = True
        _kf_blending_status = _kf_evaluate_blending(
            _KFPath("."), config=_kf_config
        )
        _kf_blending_ready = bool(_kf_blending_status.get("ready"))
        _kf_blending_reason = str(
            _kf_blending_status.get("reason") or "the paired evidence is stale"
        )
        _kf_blending_sha256 = _kf_blending_status.get("summary_sha256")
        if not _kf_blending_ready:
            _scientific_results_released = False
    if (
        isinstance(_kf_config, dict)
        and _kf_config.get("model_id") == "lrp-rli-itt-010"
        and _kf_config.get("kind") == "itt"
        and _kf_config.get("outcome_symbol") == "W"
    ):
        from language_reading_predictors.statistical_models.itt_missingness import (
            MISSINGNESS_SUMMARY_FILENAME as _KF_MISSINGNESS_FILENAME,
            sha256_file as _kf_sha256_file,
        )
        from language_reading_predictors.statistical_models.release import (
            evaluate_publication as _kf_evaluate_publication,
        )

        _kf_missingness_required = True
        _kf_missingness_decision = _kf_evaluate_publication(
            _KFPath("."), config=_kf_config
        )
        _kf_missingness_ready = bool(_kf_missingness_decision.publishable)
        _kf_missingness_reason = str(
            _kf_missingness_decision.reason or "the fit-level release check failed"
        )
        if _kf_missingness_ready:
            _kf_missingness_sha256 = _kf_sha256_file(
                _KFPath(".") / _KF_MISSINGNESS_FILENAME
            )
        else:
            _scientific_results_released = False

if not _kf_gate_is_clean:
    _kf_gate_checks = (
        _kf_gate.get("checks", {}) if isinstance(_kf_gate, dict) else {}
    )
    _kf_failed = ", ".join(
        str(name) for name, ok in _kf_gate_checks.items() if ok is not True
    ) or "missing or internally inconsistent convergence summary"
    print(
        '::: {.callout-important title="Findings withheld: sampling-quality '
        'checks failed"}\n\n'
        f"The current fit did not pass the complete convergence gate "
        f"(failed or unavailable: {_kf_failed}), so no stored findings are "
        "released. See Technical checks before interpreting any estimate."
        "\n\n:::"
    )
elif _kf_blending_required and not _kf_blending_ready:
    print(
        '::: {.callout-important title="Findings withheld: response-link '
        'evidence is not current"}\n\n'
        "Phoneme blending requires the current, trace-bound ordinary-logit and "
        "one-in-three guessing-floor pair before any stored finding is released "
        f"({_kf_blending_reason}). Rebuild the pair and regenerate key findings."
        "\n\n:::"
    )
elif _kf_missingness_required and not _kf_missingness_ready:
    print(
        '::: {.callout-important title="Findings withheld: full-cohort '
        'sensitivity is not current"}\n\n'
        "Word reading requires the complete trace-backed screening-baseline, MAR, "
        "jump-to-reference and delta-grid bundle before any stored finding is "
        f"released ({_kf_missingness_reason}). Repair or rerun the bundle and "
        "regenerate the key findings.\n\n:::"
    )
elif not _kf_path.exists():
    print(
        '::: {.callout-note title="Key findings"}\n\n'
        "A key-findings summary is not available for this fit (it predates the "
        "key-findings feature). Re-run `scripts/regenerate_key_findings.py` over "
        "this output directory to generate one, or read the results section "
        "below.\n\n:::"
    )
else:
    with open(_kf_path) as _kf_fh:
        _kf = _kf_json.load(_kf_fh)
    _kf_status = _kf.get("status")
    if _kf_blending_required and _kf.get(
        "blending_link_sensitivity_sha256"
    ) != _kf_blending_sha256:
        _scientific_results_released = False
        print(
            '::: {.callout-important title="Findings withheld: response-link '
            'summary changed"}\n\n'
            "The stored phoneme-blending key findings are not bound to the current "
            "paired sensitivity file. Regenerate `key_findings.json` before "
            "interpreting or releasing this report.\n\n:::"
        )
    elif _kf_missingness_required and _kf.get(
        "itt_missingness_sensitivity_sha256"
    ) != _kf_missingness_sha256:
        _scientific_results_released = False
        print(
            '::: {.callout-important title="Findings withheld: missingness '
            'summary changed"}\n\n'
            "The stored word-reading key findings are not bound to the current "
            "full-randomised-cohort sensitivity table. Regenerate "
            "`key_findings.json` before interpreting or releasing this report."
            "\n\n:::"
        )
    elif _kf_status == "gate_failed":
        # A secondary fit can fail even when diagnostics_summary.json records a
        # clean primary trace. Always honour the fit-level release decision.
        _scientific_results_released = False
        _kf_checks = ", ".join(_kf.get("failing_checks", [])) or "unknown"
        print(
            '::: {.callout-important title="Findings withheld: a sampling-quality '
            'gate failed"}\n\n'
            f"The fit-level release decision records a failed or unchecked gate "
            f"(failing: {_kf_checks}), so no findings or scientific result tables "
            "are released. Repair and rerun the failed fit before interpreting it."
            "\n\n:::"
        )
    elif _kf_status == "robustness_unresolved":
        # #392 P1: the robustness release gate withheld the findings. This must be a
        # callout-important that also suppresses the scientific result tables, not the
        # soft "not available" note — the point of the gate is that the box and the
        # report's own release section can no longer say different things.
        _scientific_results_released = False
        _kf_reason = _kf.get("reason") or "required robustness evidence is missing"
        _kf_evidence = (_kf.get("release") or {}).get("evidence")
        _kf_next = (
            f" Attach {_kf_evidence}, then regenerate the key-findings file."
            if _kf_evidence
            else ""
        )
        print(
            '::: {.callout-important title="Findings withheld: robustness evidence '
            'is unresolved"}\n\n'
            f"The fit passed its sampling-quality checks, but {_kf_reason}, so no "
            f"cause-and-effect statement is released.{_kf_next}\n\n:::"
        )
    elif _kf_status == "artifacts_incomplete":
        # #394 design point 3: a required output is absent or invalid, so what the
        # report would render is not a complete, auditable fit. Like the
        # robustness withhold this suppresses the result tables rather than printing
        # a soft note — a findings box built from an incomplete directory would be
        # reporting on files nobody can check.
        _scientific_results_released = False
        _kf_incomplete = ", ".join(_kf.get("missing_artifacts", [])) or "unknown"
        print(
            '::: {.callout-important title="Findings withheld: required outputs '
            'are incomplete"}\n\n'
            "Required fit artefacts are missing or invalid "
            f"({_kf_incomplete}), so no findings are summarised. Restore or "
            "regenerate the affected outputs, then regenerate the key-findings file."
            "\n\n:::"
        )
    elif _kf_status == "gate_exception":
        _kf_checks = ", ".join(_kf.get("waived_checks", [])) or "unknown"
        print(
            '::: {.callout-important title="Findings withheld: retired sampling-quality '
            'exception"}\n\n'
            "This stored summary used the retired model-spec gate exception "
            f"(checks: {_kf_checks}). It is treated as failed under the current "
            "trace-bound policy, so no findings are summarised. Regenerate the "
            "key-findings file after obtaining a clean fit.\n\n:::"
        )
    elif _kf_status == "ok" and _kf.get("sentences"):
        _kf_lines = "\n".join(f"- {s['text']}" for s in _kf["sentences"])
        print(f'::: {{.callout-tip title="Key findings"}}\n\n{_kf_lines}\n\n:::')
    else:
        _kf_reason = _kf.get("reason") or "the fit's summary files are missing"
        print(
            '::: {.callout-note title="Key findings"}\n\n'
            f"A key-findings summary is not available for this fit ({_kf_reason}). "
            "See the results section below.\n\n:::"
        )
```
